spans.s:
ज्यैष्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a month (May — June),
the month in which the full moon stands in the
constellation Jyeṣṭhā; (ई), f. the full moon in the
month Jyaiṣṭha; a small house-lizard.
—ज्यैष्ठ-
सामन्, a wrong form for ज्येष्ठ-सामन्, q. v.

ज्यैष्ठिनेय, अस्, ई, अम्, born from the elder or
principal wife; ज्यैष्ठिनेयो ज्येष्ठः, the eldest
son and at the same time the son of the father's
first wife.

ज्यैष्ठ्य, अम्, n. pre-eminence, sovereignty; pre-
cedence, priority of birth, primogeniture, seniority.
